Inside Macintosh: Telephony /
Chapter 3 - Directory Numbers / Directory Number Reference

Result Codes

This section describes the result codes for the functions discussed in this chapter.
telNoErr
The function completed without error.
telBadDNDType
Bad Do Not Disturb type specified.
telBadDNErr
The directory number record is invalid or cannot be found.
telBadDNType
Bad directory number type specified.
telBadHandErr
The specified record handle is invalid.
telBadIndex
Bad index specified.
telBadSelect
Unable to select or deselect specified directory number.
telBadTermErr
The telephone record handle is not valid.
telDNDTypeNotSupp
Specified Do Not Disturb type not supported by telephone tool.
telDNTypeNotSupp
Specified directory number type not supported by telephone tool.
telFeatActive
Specified feature is already active.
telFeatNotAvail
Specified feature is subscribed but not available.
telFeatNotSub
Specified feature is not subscribed.
telFeatNotSupp
Specified feature is not supported by telephone tool.
telFwdTypeNotSupp
Specified forwarding type not supported by telephone tool.
telIndexNotSupp
Specified index not supported.
telNoMemErr
Not enough memory is available.
